title: Capture of Cambarão
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Cambarão", at revision 1378916379, opens: "In 1614, the Persian army led by Imam Quli Khan conquered the Portuguese fort of Cambarão." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q121408251, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1614 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
